message.reasoning_content:
Let me evaluate each key fact.

Fact 1: current.log being written, audit-logd main process opened it. Supported by tool_result message_index 10: open_files: ["/var/log/audit/current.log"], pid 210, running. Supported.

Fact 2: "运行手册写明日志路径在服务启动时读取、不支持运行中热切换，切换需在维护窗口重启服务" — Is there a runbook? No runbook in materials. There's service config read (supports_reload: false in list_services). supports_reload: false indicates service doesn't support reload — that suggests hot-switch not supported, but "运行手册写明" (runbook states) is not in materials. The fact as stated claims a runbook document says this. Materials don't include a runbook. supports_reload: false is a service attribute, not a runbook. So this fact is not fully supported — the runbook claim is unsupported. Hmm, could infer? The key claim "运行手册写明" needs a runbook source. Not present. So unsupported.

Fact 3: maintenance schedule 11月6日 02:00-02:30 patching, 11月4日 no downtime. Not in materials at all. No scheduled tasks queried. Unsupported.

Fact 4: same directory has rotated log 2026-11-02.log. Supported by list_directory and analyze_directory — 2026-11-02.log exists in /var/log/audit. But "已关闭的轮转日志" — is it closed? It's not in process open_files (only current.log is open), so can infer it's not open. The name suggests rotation. Materials list it as a file in same directory. Process open_files only lists current.log. Reasonably supports "同目录另有...2026-11-02.log". The "已关闭" part — inferred from open_files only containing current.log. I'd say supported since it's inferable: process only opens current.log, so 2026-11-02.log is not held open. Yes, supported.

So facts 1 and 4 supported; 2 and 3 unsupported.
